sanskrit_verse:
निमित्तमक्षरः कर्ता बोद्धा गुणी वशी ।
अजः शरीरग्रहणात् स जात इति कीर्त्यते ॥
transliteration: nimittam akṣaraḥ kartā boddhā guṇī vaśī | ajaḥ śarīragrahaṇāt sa jāta iti kīrtyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Immutable Witness is the instrumental cause; He is the Doer, the Knower, the Qualifier, the Sovereign Controller. Though unborn, He is said to take birth due to the assumption of a body.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the Immutable Witness, not from empirical agency
Causation is rooted in the witnessing consciousness, not in physical action alone
Capacity-based responsibility lies in alignment with the witnessing Self, not in external roles
Restoration logic arises through recognition of the unchanging Doer behind all activity
Consciousness alignment supersedes behavioral correction as the basis of justice
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity assumes bodily identity THEN its actions are attributed to that embodied form WHILE the Immutable Witness remains the ultimate causal agent
IF misalignment occurs THEN restoration requires reorientation to the witnessing Self rather than punitive response
IF capacity for dharma is obscured THEN realign through conscious acknowledgment of the unchanging Doer
IF legal attribution is required THEN bind only to the level of identification with body-mind, never to the Immutable Witness
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that while embodied individuals bear conditional liability, ultimate agency rests in the Immutable Witness. Therefore, judgments must distinguish between personal karma-bound acts and the transcendent source of awareness, ensuring no attribution of guilt to pure consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that action arises from the embodied instrument while the true Doer remains untouched. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that identification with the body leads to apparent birth and action. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of identification. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that only the false ego bears conditioning, not the eternal Witness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Facilitate full recognition of the witnessing Self beyond bodily identifications
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reorient the individual to their role as observer and chooser, not merely actor
Capacity Restoration: Strengthen discriminative awareness between self and non-self
Integrity Reintegration: Align judicial process with the indivisible sovereignty of consciousness
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Dharma. Justice flows from recognition of the Immutable Witness. Dharma is restored through consciousness realignment. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
